common_baseline.geometry: Semantic marker H then44x57 indexed backward lattice
common_baseline.missing: Cubic griddata, remaining NaNs to[0,0] in Tang adaptation inspected M3
common_baseline.orientation: 8-class network, only quarter rotations explicitly decoded in inspected adaptation
common_baseline.sampling: Inspected native third-place adaptation mixes W-1 normalization and align_corners=False
common_baseline.weights: Downloaded, hash-verified and loaded strictly in M3
common_baseline.license_note: Training repo MIT. Dataset metadata licenseUnknown. Tang adaptation has no root LICENSE. Do not redistribute source/weights by conflating these.

entries.title: 1st place solution
entries.authors: outrunner, Yijun, Arya, Bob, Shane Hsieh
entries.family: Heng + fitted surface + direct RGB remapping
entries.geometry: Weighted grid coordinates, fitted surface rejects outliers and fills gaps
entries.missing_support: Interpolation or regression, no support certificate described
entries.rgb_sampling: 3200x2400 H raster then remap, plus direct remap from rotated source
entries.comment: Winner authors are outrunner, Yijun, Arya, Bob and Shane Hsieh. The writeup has no linked complete code release. Local remapping/resampling illustrations use one image, validation uses 10 IDs and 30 images.

entries.title: 2nd place solution
entries.geometry: Explicitly unchanged stage 0 and 1
entries.comment: Main innovations are waveform masks, cross-lead features and signal postprocessing. Training repo is a refactor with author warning about possible behavior regressions.

entries.title: 3rd place solution
entries.geometry: Low-resolution H and grid estimated, scaled to original resolution
entries.missing_support: Cubic griddata, remaining NaNs to source [0,0] in inspected code
entries.rgb_sampling: High-resolution warpPerspective, grid_sample and resize cascade
entries.comment: Parabolic subpixel refinement belongs to waveform decoding, not grid localization. Native coordinate convention has a measured M3 half-pixel mismatch.

entries.title: 4th Place Solution
entries.geometry: 704x704 sliding windows with 50% overlap detect crossings and layout, separate indexed line heads, dense grid_sample
entries.orientation: Layout separators and calibration pulses select quarter rotation
entries.grid_identity: 55 vertical and 43 horizontal labels plus background, radius6 majority vote
entries.comment: Own annotations around1000 images, ConvNeXt Small DINOv3 plus ECG FCMAE pretraining. Shared grid_sample idea does not mean reused checkpoint.

entries.title: 5th place solution: Multi-stages Heatmap-based Modeling
entries.family: Dense landmarks + iterative registration + local homographies
entries.geometry: 2422 points, MINIMA-RoMa pseudo-labels, ConvNeXt UNet, local K4 or K16 H, spline alternative
entries.orientation: EfficientVIT B2 quarter rotation plus continuous sine/cosine angle
entries.grid_identity: 57 semantic anchors and 2365 grid crossings, gated Hungarian matching with local expansion
entries.scale_or_template: 43x55 grid plus anchors in Type0001 template
entries.missing_support: Local inferred coordinates replace unmatched points. Exterior cell index clipped in inspected crop.py
entries.rgb_sampling: One crop from raw RGB, Lanczos4 preferred, optional flow smoothing default0
entries.comment: Hard selection of independent per-cell H has no C0 guarantee. Author explains bias/noise tradeoff but no seam or injectivity guarantee. See source code and separate author ablation source.

entries.title: 6th place solution
entries.family: Heng-derived baseline, no rectifier change documented
entries.geometry: Stage2 direct signal regression is the focus
entries.comment: FFT resampling and soft-argmax improvements concern waveform extraction, not a new rectifier.

entries.title: 7th place solution
entries.family: Rotation + lead crops, no explicit nonlinear grid rectifier described
entries.geometry: Hybrid lead detector and segmentation, two-pass AOI crop, direct digitization
entries.missing_support: Crop safeguards, no geometric support certificate
entries.rgb_sampling: Crops fed to networks, no full-image unwarp specified
entries.comment: OOD ArcFace cosine gating suppresses a specialized expert. A useful independent arm for grid absence, not proof of metric image rectification.

entries.title: 8th Place Solution
entries.geometry: Imanishi: own stage0 and Heng stage1 with one-pass RGB sampling. James: DINOv2 30 landmarks and H only. Liu: baseline stage0/1
entries.grid_identity: Imanishi and Liu inherit Heng. James uses text and signal endpoints
entries.rgb_sampling: Imanishi single F.grid_sample. James native-resolution H
entries.comment: James reports non-affine preprocessing and differentiable end-to-end warping did not work well in his trials. This is a negative result with limited tuning, not an impossibility proof.

entries.title: 9th Place Solution
entries.geometry: ALIKED+LightGlue template matching and RANSAC H, synthetic-only UNet grid detector, affine triangles
entries.orientation: Try four rotations, choose most feature matches
entries.grid_identity: Hungarian seeds in low-error regions, BFS grid expansion using about40px pitch
entries.rgb_sampling: Piecewise affine image warp, kernel not stated
entries.comment: UHDM demoire applied for source006 before grid detection. About22k synthetic grid-training images. No complete solution code linked in writeup.

entries.title: 10th Place Solution - Yolo+Unet
entries.geometry: YOLOv12 22 landmarks and H, then either crossing Delaunay or dense indexed-line UNet
entries.grid_identity: Earlier: 2 unlabeled line channels and spatial enumeration. Later:54 vertical and42 horizontal classes
entries.missing_support: Some missing landmarks tolerated by H. Grid completion unspecified
entries.rgb_sampling: Delaunay triangles or dense per-line remapping, kernel unspecified
entries.comment: Author calls H linear. It is a projective map. Prose reports large downstream gain from indexing but no isolated geometry benchmark or code link.

entries.title: 11th Place Solution
entries.geometry: Iterative correction of grid coordinates using x and y equal spacing
entries.comment: Reports about0.35dB for supported types. Equal image spacing assumes near-affine local geometry and is unsafe as an unconditional prior for wrinkles or perspective.

entries.title: 12th place solution
entries.family: Sparse landmark Delaunay + learned mask correction
entries.geometry: 17 heatmap keypoints, extend corners and add4 points, Type1 Delaunay triangles. Later learned warp on segmentation mask
entries.orientation: OCR, also auxiliary orientation head in point model
entries.grid_identity: 17 distinct channels, weighted components, PAF auxiliary task
entries.scale_or_template: Fixed Type1 layout, reference points upscaled2x
entries.missing_support: Manual right-edge corrections, corner extension. No support certificate
entries.rgb_sampling: Triangle RGB warp, then learned 2D grid sampling of predicted mask
entries.comment: Also learns a 1D signal resampler. Distortion augmentation intentionally leaves mask targets canonical so the signal model learns residual unwarping. No full code link in writeup.

entries.title: 13th Place Solution
entries.geometry: Explicit baseline stage0/1 preprocessing
entries.comment: Differentiable centroid and1D ResUNet are signal stages. They must not be counted as stronger image rectification.

entries.title: 14th Place Solution
entries.geometry: Pretrained stage0/1 checkpoints, waveform HRNet innovations
entries.scale_or_template: Writeup reports3024x4032 normalization, needs code verification
entries.comment: Claim of perfectly aligned output is prose, not a certificate. Ablation author says changes were not isolated.

entries.title: 15th place solution
entries.family: Heng with canvas and pixel convention fix
entries.geometry: Fixed canvas, truncate unstable last grid column, empirical scanner offsets
entries.scale_or_template: 1700 output height, source cropped to2166 columns, offsets7y34x
entries.missing_support: Borders still use padding_mode=border in published snippet
entries.rgb_sampling: Normalize by W-1/H-1 and align_corners=True for field and RGB
entries.comment: Explicit earlier publication of endpoint/corner convention repair. Our M3 identity-ramp measurement is an independent audit, not novelty of this repair.

entries.title: 17th Place Solution: An Alternative Rectification Workflow
entries.family: Classical SIFT H + learned original-resolution grid
entries.geometry: Masked common template SIFT, RANSAC with loose threshold, sliding-window point heatmaps and line-mask false-positive filter
entries.orientation: Template feature matching. Separate D4 guarantee absent
entries.grid_identity: Structured grid assembly anchored near template
entries.scale_or_template: Template H gives common scale, full1700x2200 signal image
entries.comment: Weighted local probabilities give grid subpixel coordinates. Trained using augmented Type0001. No code/checkpoint link in writeup.

entries.title: 21st Place Solution
entries.geometry: 2400x1920 H image, two5-layer CNNs refine31x31 point patches with5px then2px translation tolerance
entries.rgb_sampling: High-resolution rectification, exact kernel not stated
entries.comment: 800 manual training locations and180 validation, reported0.146px mean point error. Labeler displayed original prediction, so possible anchoring. No independent fold/generalization proof or released code linked.

entries.title: 24th Place Solution
entries.geometry: No new rectification method described
entries.comment: Cross-row attention, deformable features and BiLSTM refine signals. These do not prove better coordinate maps.

entries.title: 26th Place Solution
entries.authors: Boredom, Vampire, Shuyang Jiang, Large_Supper, BeeBoo
entries.geometry: Own UNet grid training with manual correction of pseudo-labels
entries.missing_support: Missing grid points filled using directional vectors
entries.comment: Stage1 trained with about10k synthetic images. Five-fold patient grouping is stated for the signal stage. Directional completion merits matched-observation boundary tests.

entries.title: 27th place solution - Only Pre&Postprocessing
entries.authors: Zhihao Zhu, Van Dong Tran, BanhMiMatOng
entries.geometry: Run raw and preprocessed stage0/1, choose by stage1 quality
entries.rgb_sampling: Shared rectifier, source-specific mild intensity preprocessing
entries.comment: Author reports dual-path and type-aware improvements. Quality gate formula and complete notebook URL are not supplied in writeup. Example preprocessing snippet has inconsistent variable names, so treat as design sketch.

entries.title: 51st place solution
entries.authors: Ray, COLA KE LIU, HanCheng Li, JjaHe Li, Eddie Sun
entries.family: Three-stage H + learned grid, provenance incomplete
entries.geometry: ResNet34 alignment, U-Net grid lines/intersections, dense flow
entries.missing_support: Signal interpolation discussed, geometry completion unspecified
entries.comment: Main contribution is signal heatmap smoothing and gap filling. ResNet34 stage0 description differs from Heng native ResNet18, so do not claim binary equivalence without code.

entries.title: PhysioNet | 97th place solution
entries.geometry: Shared stage0/1, photometric changes before stage0 and stage2
entries.comment: Title97, current author metadata93. Stronger demoire filtering before H. Recolors detected thin black grid candidates red before signal stage, a preservation risk requiring RGB-original comparison.

entries.title: 97th Place Solution
entries.geometry: No new trained models, public stage0/1, grayscale/original/HSV branches
entries.comment: Title97 with slug104th-place-solution. Current author metadata97. This is inference diversity, not new geometry. No notebook link supplied in writeup.

entries.title: 🥉PhysioNet 98th place solution Training+Inference
entries.geometry: Source classifier and optional source-aware preprocessing
entries.comment: Title and narrative98, current author metadata91. Do not resolve discrepancy by guessing final placement.
